idea-plugin.name: katachi
idea-plugin.description:
Experimental. An early preview released together with katachi: its screens and behavior may change in any release. It is not on JetBrains Marketplace; it is distributed as a zip attached to each GitHub Release and installed with Settings > Plugins > Install Plugin from Disk.

Generate code from the templates of your katachi architecture. Start from the katachi tool window, from New > katachi in the Project tree, or from the notification that appears in the editor when a template fits the file you opened (it can be turned off in Settings > Tools > katachi). Pick a template, or a templateSet (several templates generated together), fill in its arguments and press Generate; katachi's Gradle task writes the files. The fields for a directory name suggest the directories that already exist at that place.

While you write a definition, the IDE completes names (for example arg("...")) and underlines mistakes, and the definition file shows a ◆ on the declarations of roles and templates with a Code Vision of how many files they hold. Live templates write the skeleton of a definition at the top level of a Kotlin file: katachirole (a role), katachigroup (a group), katachiarchitecture (the architecture), katachifilecontent (a role's ktFileContent as a function), katachitemplate (a template's content as a function), katachitemplateset (a templateSet as a function) and katachitest (the architecture test), named after the file (ServiceRole.kt gives the role Service); inside a role, katachikonsist writes a named konsist constraint.

Also shown in the editor: a ◆ in the gutter of every file a role holds (with a menu to jump to the role, its templates and the other files of the role), and the violations of the last check under the declaration they reject. A file that no role holds gets a notification with a draft of the role to copy, and katachi: Run Architecture Check runs the check. The screens follow the IDE's language: Japanese when the IDE is in Japanese, English otherwise.

AI agents can use katachi through the JetBrains MCP Server: they read the roles, templates and violations, run the check and, once you allow it in Settings > Tools > katachi, generate from a template.

A *.katachi.kts (katachi's commands written as a Kotlin script) is completed with the definition the installed katachi CLI provides (brew install tbsten/tap/katachi). Without a CLI the script shows a notification on how to get one, and nothing else of the plugin changes.

Needs a Gradle project that applies the katachi Gradle plugin 0.2.0 or later (id("me.tbsten.katachi")); the gutter, the violations and templateSets need 0.3.0 or later. See Generate code from template.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.4.0 (with katachi 0.4.0; the version follows katachi's from here, so there is no 0.3.0):

  • Tools for AI agents on the JetBrains MCP Server: read the roles, templates and violations, reload the definition, run the check, and generate from a template (generation is off until you turn it on in Settings > Tools > katachi). Not in Android Studio, which has no MCP Server.
  • A *.katachi.kts is completed with the definition the installed katachi CLI provides; without a CLI, a notification says how to get one.
  • Live templates for the skeleton of a definition: katachirole, katachigroup, katachiarchitecture, katachifilecontent, katachitemplate, katachitemplateset, katachitest and katachikonsist (Settings > Editor > Live Templates > katachi).
  • The gutter, the violations under a declaration, the ◆ and Code Vision follow the IDE's language (Japanese / English).
  • In English, the members of a templateSet row in the tool window are separated by ", ".
  • Fixed: an IDE started from the Dock (macOS) finds the kotlin command the katachi CLI runs on.
  • Fixed: Android Studio with its default Gradle sync settings (no task list built during sync) finds the module that holds the katachi definition, instead of showing "katachi is not found".
  • Needs IntelliJ IDEA 2026.1 (261) or later.

0.2.0 (with katachi 0.3.0):

  • templateSet: a set of templates is listed and generated like a template.
  • Suggestions for the directory names of a capture field in the tool window and the generate dialog.
  • While writing a definition: completion, errors shown in the editor, a ◆ on the declarations of the definition file, and Code Vision.
  • The ◆ in the gutter and the violations of the last check under the declaration they reject.
  • The editor notification names the template (or counts them), and a failed generation can copy its command.
  • A notification on a file that no role holds (with a draft of the role to copy), and "katachi: Run Architecture Check" to run the check.
  • Settings are grouped into definition, editor and generation. "Reload Templates" and "Reload Architecture Definition" are now "Reload Definition".

0.1.0 (with katachi 0.2.0): the first release, experimental. The katachi tool window, New > katachi, and the editor notification on files a template fits, in English and Japanese.
